item.title: With Sophia Stepping Back From KATSEYE, Will the Global Girl Group Remain a Quartet?
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to the Billboard Pop Shop Podcast. I'm Katie.
Co-Host: And I'm Keith. Today, we're discussing the latest news in the pop world.
Host: KATSEYE, the global girl group, has just announced that Sophia will be taking a step back to prioritize her mental health and wellness. This comes after a similar announcement from groupmate Manon back in February. The group is now down to four members, and it's unclear when either Sophia or Manon might return.
Co-Host: This news comes at a busy time for KATSEYE, with their new album "Wild" out now and their "Wildworld Tour" kicking off in October. We'll be discussing what this means for the group's future. Will they remain a quartet, or will Sophia and Manon return?
Host: In other chart news, Ariana Grande's new album "petal" has debuted at number one on the Billboard 200 chart, and the title track has entered the top five on the Billboard Hot 100 songs chart.
Co-Host: And Ella Langley's "Choosin' Texas" is still holding strong at number one for a 17th week, fending off a challenge from Grande's former number one "hate that I made you love me."
Host: Tune in to our full conversation to get all the latest pop news and chart updates. You can stream us on Billboard.com or download our podcast on your favorite platform.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Thanks for listening to the Billboard Pop Shop Podcast. Join us next time for more pop news and chart discussions.
Co-Host: And don't forget to follow us on Billboard.com for all the latest music news and updates.
